name: Mage
description: A wielder of Aether magic. Mages command devastating spells but are fragile in close quarters.

skills.name: Arcane Bolt
skills.description: Hurl a bolt of pure Aether energy. Scales with Intelligence.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.description: Blast all enemies with frost, dealing damage and slowing for 2 turns.

skills.name: Mana Shield
skills.description: Convert incoming damage to MP cost for 3 turns.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Launch an explosive fireball dealing massive fire damage.

skills.name: Arcane Storm
skills.description: Unleash a storm of Aether on all enemies for devastating damage.
